notes.title: Today's the day!
notes.content:
It has now been almost 7 months since we started working on Magnet Crusher.

7 months during which we poured our energy and our passion, trying to turn what was once a simple idea about an original gameplay into a fully-fledged gaming experience. And today's the day you all can see the result. MAGNET CRUSHER is now available on Steam, and for free on Android and iOS.

When we decided to start ToccGames, my brother and I wanted to create fun and unique games. Without any experience in the gaming industry, with barely any prior knowledge, only pushed by the same thing we all have here: the love for games.

MAGNET CRUSHER is our first decent-sized game, and to say this was not a stroll in the park would be an understatement. Cross-progression, UI designed for mobile, keyboard and controller, online ranking, Twitch integration, and, obviously, making the game as fun as possible. All these obstacles and challenges we had to solve allowed us to grow and learn as game creators. And to finally see our efforts come to fruition, to finally be able to show you something we can be proud of is very exciting (and also a bit scary).

So, to those who supported us, thank you for your patience and for sticking with us. For those who are about to play MAGNET CRUSHER, we hope you enjoy the game as much as we do. See you soon!

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 2046: Woah more than 2000 hours of work now, time to promote!
notes.content:
Plop Toccers,

How are you? On our side it was a nice week, we got some feedback on the game which will help us to improve it. Do not hesitate to come here or on Steam to comment and give feedback it is always appreciated.

So what did we do last week, I can say it quick, we promote, promote and promote Magnet Crusher. I spend the whole week reaching press media one by one and sending the steam key. The goal behind it is to get some coverage on the release date of the 6th of April.

Apart from that, we make a lot of improvements and small bug fixing, so I will not go deep into details.

But what was interesting and that we did a lot of playtesting too, on the Twitch mode, on the adventure mode, and so on.

We completely review the difficulty curve of the game which is now slightly more difficult when you are approaching the end of the adventure mode.

I think that is all that needs to be said, to sum up, the previous week.



Let's make a quick stats overview of the Magnet Crusher development, I know some Toccers like these kinds of data:

It is now more than 2000 hours of work that we are working on Magnet Crusher, which sounds awesome to me. I will provide more stats data in future news when the game will be finally out ^^.

In these words, I wish you a good week and see you at the next one.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1965: Marketing time time time! Twitch mode improvement
notes.content:
Plop Toccers,

How are you this week?

On our side the last week was still a very busy one. We improved a lot our game with some visual aspects (level display in the background).

We also decided to rework the home menu of the Arcade menu. Before you land on a page where you were able to select and assign your powers. Now you land on a similar page as the survival menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/5f18286d45ceaaceda398a4648ecca3ceae78754.png[/img]

And we are now 16 days away from the Magnet Crusher release on the 6th of April.

we are between fear and excitement. Anyway, it was and is still an incredible project that we are proud of we have done.

So this new week starting will be focused on marketing and fixing issues on the game. Yes, it is now time to show the game to the most possible people.

Have a good week everyone and see you next week.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1874: Big week and survival mode for streamer
notes.content:
Plop Toccers,

This last week was for sure our biggest week in terms of work.
We were able to add a new and last game mode into Magnet Crusher. Let me present you the survival mode:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/bfe89bc23177b875eec5554c81970e122a5e26ef.png[/img]

The survival mode is a game mode where you have to survive the longest time possible. Your rank will be done from the score but enemies will be more and more numerous and dangerous.

As long as your score is increasing, you will reach a new survival level which offers you the possibility to choose a bonus.
I will not give you more information and let you discover the game mode.

One big thing coming with this new game mode is the mode for streamers.
We added to this mode the possibility to connect your twitch account to allow your viewers to interact with your game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/973b6993019d3b9edcab4057621ce48b84d2e7e8.png[/img]

Your viewer can help you or completely make your game harder. But finally, when the game ends you will know who was real support or not at all with a viewer leaderboard.

There are also streamer-specific leaderboards to check how you performed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/76cdb2d4141b54118871de2207871853bcc24346.png[/img]

By the way, if you are interested in testing the game before its release on the 6th of April, feel free to contact us, we are still in tester needs.

With that said, we wish you an excellent week and see you next Monday.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1766: Survival mode ongoing
notes.content:
Plop Toccers,

J - 30 before the release of Magnet Crusher. The counter is going down and excitement is rising.

We still have the last thing to add to the game and it is something that we talked a bit about on Twitch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/451662e224533daa0d8dd51268aa526520bc6ee4.png[/img]

This mode will be a brand new way of playing Magnet Crusher with another objective. Now you will have to survive as long as possible.

And this mode will welcome a connection with Twitch in order to allow streamers to play by interacting with their viewers.

We will share mode information in the following days about this new game mode.

Another big achievement we were able to reach, is that we succeed in porting the game to IOS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/b99cc96f1559e7ad48753638d5ece27dba1e858d.png[/img]

So for the release on the 6th of April, the game will be available on Steam, PlayStore for Android, and AppStore for IOS.

Now we only have 30 days to complete and fix the last bugs of the game. In the meantime, we will start pushing our communication with the press and influencers.

We wish you a good week and see you next week.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1687: Release approaching
notes.content:
Hi Toccers,

How are you these days?

On our side the last week was a tough and busy week, but we were able to reach nearly all our goals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/08594e06ab8f7f823f55323c9ead423df5aefa75.png[/img]

And to start, let's talk about the great news, the Magnet Crusher demo is out and everyone can test it on Steam.

Then the open beta version is available on Android too:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ToccGames.MagnetCrusher

This was a great achievement for us. Being able to see players playing Magnet Crusher was cool and we already have found some improvement to be made.

We are also working on making the Magnet Crusher soundtracks available on Steam and streaming platforms like Spotify. This requires a little more time but will be available soon.

And finally, the Magnet Crusher trailer will be revealed tomorrow. We worked a lot on it and we think it shows how our arcade game is intense and fun.

We will reveal it tomorrow on our live stream on Twitch around 3:00 pm GTM + 1:
https://www.twitch.tv/toccgameslive
We generally speak French but feel free to talk with us.


And now what?

We are focusing on 4 subjects for the last weeks:

[list]
[*]The survival mode
[*]The survival streamer mode (Twitch)
[*]The IOS portage
[*]Polish, polish, bug fixes, polish, polish
[/list]

So we are busy as hell but we really think we will be able to achieve it and release the game as expected on 6 April 2020.

So let's go back to work.

Have a good week everyone.

notes.title: Demo available !
notes.content:
Dear Toccers,

After months of work, we are approaching the release of Magnet Crusher.
To make you wait until that date, we are happy to offer you access to the demo of Magnet Crusher.

We hope you will enjoy it!

Have fun

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1603: Demo and Trailer
notes.content:
Plop Toccers,

I hope everyone is doing good.

Let's start with a short update on how things are moving for our small team and our game Magnet Crusher:

I think we can say that we are starting to the end of the tunnel, it is a french expression but I do not know if everyone can understand it properly ^^.

Anyway, these past days we had improved a lot of small aspects of the game and fixed a lot of small bugs. So we can now say that the game is playable completely even if we have still some updates to make to push it a little bit forward.

We added an animated background to make the game more attractive even when there are not so many enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/e3976a2cde72632cdaf735e7b22732a1930a3db9.png[/img]

The UI has been improved also, with the new HP bar and a new power button more visible.

We also improved the power of visual effects with new animation and VFX, feedbacks are now a lot more visible.

And finally the big news: we started to work on our release trailer and our demo version.

Both will be available for the next devlog so for the end of the week. We'll see if we can get some feedback from you, players.

and with that, I wish you a good week.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1515: Final rush
notes.content:
Plop Toccers,

It is a pleasure to give you news after these two weeks of break and rest. We are now ready to complete the game for the release still planned for the end of March.

These days with Turnip we focus on bug solving and polish and I think we can say that we are aligned to deliver a demo / playtest / beta mobile version for the end of our current sprint, I mean the end of February.

On my side, I spent time making the game available for low-end mobile devices. This required some adjustment in terms of performance. More precisely I needed to turn off some post-process effect for very low-end devices.

We also rework a bit the sound design of the game to make them less high frequency (on the very good advice of one of our viewers on Twitch https://www.twitch.tv/toccgameslive)

The rest of the time I barely fixed the main bugs which were preventing the game to be playable (I guess it was important ^^.



Turnip completed the skin list and we finally have our animated skins ^^. Take a look at some of them :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/aa38074e2833abf5849217ef5124c8115c10083a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/18835244986bbedfd43e83744921a73eedbfb94c.png[/img]

I really think these skins are cool ^^. You will have to play to check all others.



We still have a lot of work to do but we are approaching the result and we are proud of what we make. The wait is almost over for those who would like to test Magnet Crusher on Pc or Mobile. We hope you will enjoy it and if not share your feedback.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1365: Adventure mode done
notes.content:
Plop Toccers,

And here we go, the adventure mode is finally complete. By complete, I mean all the levels, bosses, and bonuses are now integrated into the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/eab1f6d1fec89fa8191637ee09eab190fb11a1fd.png[/img]

We spent the week finalizing the bonus level system which are levels with some different objectives or specific tricks.

Turnip worked on completing the list of skins for the release and especially the ones which will be gifted for the best arcade player of the week.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/048f0194c291d4ea33a403cb9666d149d8ad0897.png[/img]

For another sad news, the next devlogs will be mid-February as we are taking two weeks of vacation in order to be full energy for the release period ^^.

Thank you very much for reading this and see you soon.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1300: Week of boss production
notes.content:
Plop Toccers,

This was a tough week in terms of production, we are reaching the end of the production part of the game. I mean the part where we put all content for the adventure, arcade, UI, and so on.

We really want to finish this phase before the end of January to start February with adjustment and polish.

So on my side, I spent the whole week creating the 4 boss design by Turnip, and let's be honest I completely underestimated the amount of work required here. I was hoping to complete all 4 bosses by then of the week and it was not the case at all. But this is how you learn to be a game dev and a better producer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/aacd05f024a886fe8b0448c024a4a59d1e0f7bfb.png[/img]

So I worked extra time to go as far as I could and I only have the 4th boss to finish. All behaviors are created and integrated so we will just need to adjust values during playtesting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/360c3b3f2f72b00fe5be1f9270dccabf1a86f78d.png[/img]

Turnip worked on a lot of visual aspects of the game:

- Texturing for level assets like bumper and teleporter wall

- New skins for specific events in the game ^^

- Mobile input

So far the plan is respected we are still targetting February for demo and playtest which is good news ^^.

On another subject, we have changed our website provider and the website is down until I succeed to rebuild it, youhou I was very pleased to see that it will not be so easy...

And that is all news for the week, see you next Monday Toccers.
Do not forget to follow, like, and all others very useful stuff for us ^^.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1214: Boss time
notes.content:
Hellou Toccers,

Even if it was the Christmas / New Year week we kept focusing on game dev (No rest for the brave).

So on my side, I spent the whole week working on the first boss of the game. I did not expect that it took so much time. 4 days of work and we still have some adjusting to doing :

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/0a223eff90554a93245502ae63db3fdf6c262b5f.png[/img]

On the boss is all that I can say but it will be awesome ^^ when all of them will be alive.

Turnip on this side worked on achievements and some new icons for the leaderboard:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/8bfa402c551299c8507edd69ef09130b1fc07f8a.png[/img]

We are confident to reach the end of the project for Q1 even if we know we will need to work late in February ^^.

Next week we may be able to show a preview of all bosses present in the V1 of Magnet Crusher.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1148: Begining of polishing
notes.content:
Plop Toccers,

This week was special, because of Christmas of course.

But we still worked on Magnet Crusher. On my side, I focused on polishing tasks, I should not detail all stories but here is a shortlist :
- Improve pause/end game UI
- Level preview
- Sorting list of medals
- Skin visibility on UI
- ...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/d661968bcf004524dcb150b165ffd88542c9ceaa.png[/img]

The other big thing of this week was the new level feature: teleporter walls.

We are working on this aspect of levels where the player and other game elements can be teleported between two linked walls. The same mechanics as Portal if you know it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/316c5f7b4a87accd7b6eb4bf6d9435466e0bdfbe.gif[/img]

Turnip on his side was working of the bosses and bonus levels. The design of the boss is done and will be integrated the next week.

In terms of planning, I think we will need to delay the access to the public demo/beta to make it happen in February.
Firstly, because we will take some rest in the second half of January and second because now all elements are in the integration phases but we will need a lot of playtests to adjust everything.

And of these words, I hope you have a great end of the year and see you next week ^^.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1076: Skin system and adventure level integration
notes.content:
Hello, Toccers (Yes this is how we call our supporters... :)

So let's talk about this previous week, this one was tough. While Turnip was working on the bosses and bonus stage for the adventure mode, I was focused on integrating the adventure level into the game. This represents 40 levels to add to the game by creating 7 to 10 waves per level... I almost die XD.

But now all levels are created for the adventure mode, of course, it misses the boss and bonus but they will arrive soon. So we are reaching the end of the adventure level production, of course, we will need to balance the things to make the player feel he is progressing in the game but the main part is here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/6d49392c5539f79eec3d06d1853c6aaeb9fb7d59.png[/img]

On another side, I spent time working with our intern on the first skins for the game, and I can admit that it is cool to be able to change the aspect of the player. We will see if players are interested in ^^.

We hope so because it will be a part of the studio/game revenue and may determine if ToccGames will be able to survive later than 2023... no pressure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/cff43adcaa62e106a30599b2ef85646c2d4599f6.png[/img]

So things are going well, we are nearly on the schedule to show you a demo of the game in January.

Go back to work and see you next week.

notes.title: DEVLOG HOUR 1012
notes.content:
This week we are finishing our adventure mode with all the levels shapes.

These shapes require more work than usual because we are adding external blocs for enhanced the overall style of the game. These blocs will be then animated to improve the game feel maybe following the music or reacting to game events. This needs to be determined.

On another subject, we completely reworked the leaderboard UI to be able to add more content to the player scoreline. The goal behind it is to prepare the possibility to add more leaderboard tabs and maybe filter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/f0839407e0f9538b5f84419c4e221b0130d8c10c.png[/img]

We also added an achievement system, this will be synchronized with Steam. We thought that it was a good idea because it did not require a lot of work on our side, we are using the stats system to follow the unlock status.

Another big thing also, is that we are started working on a skin system for the Magnet Crusher. If we reach a state where the multiplayer begins to be interesting and if we can invest in it, this system can be a huge advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41526496/08fd758c13f119014dfd1d8490037cda44a2d099.png[/img]

Et voila, that is all for today, see you next week for more news.

See you the Toccers.
